title: A holder's own command that TermAl cannot place no longer fences its carried gates outside its workdir and current named root
outcome: The holder's own command that TermAl cannot place fences every carried check of the holder whose run is going, as a path-less edit of the holder already does; the narrowing to where a session works applies to other sessions' checks only.
acceptance: A test carries a gate, then reports an unplaced writing command of the holder in a turn without a grant (and one under another claim's named root): the carried check is fenced, and the line names the command.
Another session's unplaced command still counts only where that session works; the existing tests pass unchanged.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
